title: Young Entrepreneurs Christmas Market
seo_title: Young Entrepreneurs Christmas Market in Springfield, MO
description: Wisdom Academy's annual Christmas Market is where students sell their handmade work as young entrepreneurs, including Christmas decorations, baked goods, crafts, sewn and crocheted items, 3D-printed items, candles, and soaps. Visitors can shop for gifts and are invited to bring family and friends. It runs Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 2:00 to 3:00 PM at Graceway Baptist Church, 5010 S Farm Road 135, Springfield, MO.
address: 5010 S Farm Road 135, Springfield, MO 65810-1982, United States, Springfield, MO
